The [[Vensensor sector/Legends|Vensensor sector]] was the location of an '''Imperial Intelligence Sector HQ'''.<ref name="MB" /> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Tar Morden">{{CSWECite|III|221|Tar Morden}}</ref> a [[Tech 4 PDV|Plexus Droid Vessel]] carrying highly sensitive information on the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] new [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] manufacturing operation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tar Morden]] was intercepted by Rebels en route to the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] headquarters. It self-destructed to avoid capture and cover the jettison of its [[I2-CG droid/Legends|I2-CG droid]], which contained the information.<ref name="MB" />
